summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with Labrys Fund II, L.P. for a $290k promissory note and warrant to purchase 250k shares at $0.50/share, issued at $250k with $40k OID. The unsecured note matures 5/12/2027, with amortization starting 11/12/2026. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation.
